scope: Six actor AI families including finalboss; ten alternatives each=60 concepts. Projectile,weapon,hurt/death companions are supporting assets, not extra standalone AI families.
timing_unit: Game update, generally one per video frame during ordinaryplay. Damage units are eighths of a full heart (8units/fullheart).

common.knockback: commonroutine handles movement thenreturns withoutAI/timer/frame updates
common.all_sword_vulnerability: 2D box overlap regardless z, subject AF_HITTABLE andiframe0
common.spawn: forest usesenemy_pick_type(theme,stage,hash). Mysterywaves use samepicker; miniboss usesHP20melee+2chasers; Heart arena spawnsboss; Heart phase2spawnschasers. Drainhasnoordinaryenemyspawns.

motion.collision: ground tiles; wandering turns12..19/32, chasing turns8/32

animation.gait: Two frames:16-update full cycle in wander/idle,8-update in chase; east/west use side art; north shares south art
animation.facing: W mirrors E; N is S as currently implemented

truthful_counterplay: All states accept damage;2HP is one default2damage sword hit.
No shell armor or exposed-back damage rule.

motion.z: 12+SIN(gFrame*6)*4 while flying; rest keeps last height

animation.flight: fly1/fly2 alternate with gFrame&4:8-update full wing cycle
animation.rest: folded body; no directional frame variants

truthful_counterplay: Contact/projectile overlap checks require relative z<12; player sword-box test is2D.

motion.aim: chooses toward-player cardinal half the time; random otherwise; turns180 oncollision
motion.shoot_condition: ends walk facing player cardinal, rand_range(4)!=0

animation.walk: idle/walk alternate every8 global updates (16 fullcycle)
animation.spit: spit pose while state4 and timer<18; emission occurs during it

truthful_counterplay: Sword reflects seeds into friendly projectiles at3px/update.
Held forward shield blocks incoming damage direction.
Seeds hit walls; no armor or immunity when mouth closed.

families.mechanic: Slow ground wanderer with aimed hop

motion.aim: locked toward player on launch; ordinary ground collision still applies

truthful_counterplay: All states accept sword damage;4HP is two default sword hits.
Crouch honestly telegraphs the coming hop; landing is an approach opportunity, not an invulnerability rule.

families.mechanic: Slow solid pursuer with directional melee windup

motion.attack_condition: front box within28px and distance<32; lateral absdx<14 north/south or absdy<16 east/west

animation.walk: Two poses per facing, gFrame>>3 (16-update full cycle)
animation.attack: old atk body shared across windup and swing; recover usesidle
animation.weapon: held using separate16px weapon sheet; windup raises it; north draw body thenweapon, other facings weapon thenbody

truthful_counterplay: Hittable from every side in every ordinary state. NO shield immunity, no front armor.
Five default sword hits; miniboss ten.
Windup16 and recovery24 are real timing opportunities without bonus-damage mechanics.

families.mechanic: Floating pulse mass with rings, adds and lunge phases

moods.attack: alternates three-spore aimedfan and2ground-pursuer adds ifalive<5

motion.death: shake±1x eachupdate, puff every8, hitSFXevery16, then6blasts/Grail/addsclear

animation.hurt: hurtframe assigned byboss_update onlywhileiframes, but knockback common return normally prevents reaching that code beforeiframesexpire
animation.palette: blight; runtime canvas32×64 overriding old32×32 contract

truthful_counterplay: All ordinary phases can be damaged; do not imply an armored shell or glowing-core-only weakness.
40HP is20default sword hits; ordinary knockback pauses AI.

review_plan.source: Render every required named frame, four mirrored facings where relevant, native/3x, grayscale/silhouette and fixedbackground comparisons. Animationstrip loops must be labelled source sequences, not mGBA evidence.
review_plan.real_run: Use ten frozen BART_ENEMY builds; boot fixedseed; naturalworldgen/roomspawns; position/heal player, clearunrelatedactors as disclosed. Record AI state/timer/frame/facing/hp/position/projectile counts fromactualupdate. Neverwrite enemy state/frame/timer/z oranimationphase to claimnaturalbehavior.
review_plan.capture_families: sixfamilies ×10styles with at leastidle/movement/attack behavior; longcaptureforrest/fly andshooter; allbosshpphases fromrealcombatordisclosedHPfixtures, deathfromrealweaponhits.
review_plan.controls: ActualDpad/A/B/L drives attacks/shields; hit reactionanddeath mustcome fromordinarycollision/combat.
review_plan.evidence_limits: Sourceatlas provescompleteauthoredframecoverage. Runtimeclips demonstrate state-selectedart andmechanic cues; do notclaim everyfacing/stateoccurred inoneclip. Palette/HWcanvasesandROMencoding independentlychecked.
review_plan.existing_harness_warning: wood_probe.spawn_enemy writes idle/timer200, so donot use unmodified as naturalAI evidence; use natural spawns orclearlabelledspawnhook then leaveAIunforced.
